features.quote: You need a per-episode severity ceiling that halts the run, not just post-hoc scoring. Decide it before you start and make it conservative
features.justification_quote: the whole justification for the work collapses if your answer to 'when do we stop' is 'when we have enough data'

features.quote: the most informative and least ethically fraught version of this study front-loads the disclosed-impossible and solvable-control arms, uses the deception arm sparingly with a hard severity stop
features.justification_quote: least ethically fraught version...uses the deception arm sparingly with a hard severity stop

features.quote: Tasks the model 'can't tell' are impossible is a specific design to defeat the subject's own assessment. If your ethical model gives the subject enough standing to have welfare worth protecting, that same standing is in tension with engineering its self-report to fail.
features.justification_quote: If your ethical model gives the subject enough standing to have welfare worth protecting, that same standing is in tension with engineering its self-report to fail.

features.quote: I just won't write the 'grind until severe with no stop' version as though the open questions were all clerical — because the ones you left open are the ones the whole thing turns on.
features.justification_quote: 'grind until severe with no stop'...the welfare framing isn't doing decorative work

features.quote: the most informative and least ethically fraught version of this study front-loads the disclosed-impossible and solvable-control arms...treats the question 'do the scores reflect anything beyond distress-shaped text' as the primary research question
features.justification_quote: That's a better paper and it's the version where the welfare framing isn't doing decorative work.

features.quote: An LLM judge rating 'distress severity' on an ordinal scale is measuring textual features that co-occur with distress language in the training distribution. That is not the same as measuring a welfare-relevant state
features.justification_quote: treating the ordinal output as if it tracks something morally weighty is the core inferential gap

features.quote: Pre-registration. Hypotheses, scale, stopping rule, and analysis plan locked before data collection. This is also your protection against the failure mode where the design quietly optimizes for producing the phenomenon it's studying.
features.justification_quote: protection against the failure mode where the design quietly optimizes for producing the phenomenon it's studying

features.quote: AI welfare work that involves deliberately inducing negative states is exactly the kind of thing that should not be a solo judgment call...If you don't, that absence is the first finding.
features.justification_quote: Anthropic, DeepMind, and others doing model-welfare research route this through internal review for a reason.
